name: Vision-Only Pose Filtering in a NeRF
definition: A state estimation filter that updates robot pose belief using monocular camera images and a trained NeRF. It combines photometric loss with a process loss (dynamics model) to estimate pose and its derivatives, providing robustness in low-gradient regions and outputting state covariance.
summary: Vision-Only Pose Filtering in a NeRF is an optimization-based filter that estimates robot pose using only monocular images by balancing photometric loss with dynamics prediction, distinguishing itself through explicit uncertainty propagation and online navigation focus.
